record.question: Esther Hnamte, a child prodigy from Lunglei district received which of the following national award on December, 2025?
record.explanation: Answer A: PM-Rashtriya Bal Puraskar. The Ministry of Women and Child Development announced Esther Lalduhawmi Hnamte’s PM-Rashtriya Bal Puraskar on 26 December 2025, before this February 2026 examination. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2208803&lang=2&reg=48. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC Law & Judicial Paper-I, February 2026 examination; current officeholder/current affairs claims interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
